* refactor: separate the basic parser by @chu-shen in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/163
* refactor: extract local configuration handling to LocalConfigurationH… by @chu-shen in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/210

## New Contributors

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/compare/1.7.1...1.7.2

## What's Changed

- 优化离线数据库更新逻辑
- 近期放送的剧集始终使用在线 API 获取
- 增加 [公共标签](https://bgm.tv/group/topic/406595) 支持
- 修复 OAuth 授权时间显示不正确的问题（不影响正常使用）
- 修正查询图片时没有携带登录态的问题 #181
- 代码结构 / 打包流程调整 #159 

最新 CI 测试包可以在 https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/releases/tag/ci 下载

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/compare/1.7.0...1.7.1

## Important
 - 支持 Jellyfin 10.10.0（向下兼容 10.9.0）
 - [离线数据库](https://github.com/bangumi/Archive/) 支持：
   - 当存在离线数据时库时，优先通过离线数据库查询
   - 默认每周更新一次，可在 Jellyfin - 计划任务 中自行修改
   - 离线数据库下载解压过程需要占用约 1GB 内存，索引过程需要占用大量 CPU 资源。\
     （作为参考 M2 Mac 需要约 3 分钟，16 核的 Epyc 需要几十秒）
   - 一定程度解决 bgm.tv 挂掉或被墙导致的报错

* do not use series overview when the episode overview is empty by @huihuimoe in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/154
* fix: characters sort by relation by @chu-shen in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/156
* feat: update Anitomy by @chu-shen in https://github.com/kookxiang/jellyfin-plugin-bangumi/pull/157

Moonbase is the Moonfin server plugin for Jellyfin, powering settings sync, the Moonfin Web app at /Moonfin/Web/, a built-in theme editor with custom theme APIs, media bar and ratings integrations, and Seerr proxy/SSO with admin defaults and broadcasts across Moonfin clients.

versions.changelog:
Moonbase 2.4.0 is the server side of Moonfin 2.7.0. It builds the new seasonal Home row, gives custom rows each title's rating and holds them to parental limits, gets large MDBList rows loading, and matches anime with non-English library titles. It also syncs the settings the new clients added and bundles the Moonfin 2.7.0 web app.

Features:

- A seasonal Home row of holiday movies a user owns, plus Seerr suggestions, for New Year's, Valentine's Day, Easter, Pride, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Lunar New Year and Diwali. Clients turn it on, and a new Moonfin Seasonal Keywords Sync task fills in TMDB keywords using the server-wide TMDB key.
- Custom row items carry the TMDB certification, overview, genres and runtime, and rows fetched with a user's own TMDB or MDBList key are cached for that user.
- The bottom bar style and tabs, the Friends button, detail screen sections and seasonal effect density now sync, with admin defaults for the bottom bar, the Friends button, the new seasonal effects, density, the seasonal row and the Great-Grandparents interface size.
- The bundled web app moves up to Moonfin 2.7.0, with friends and chat from the Achievement Badges plugin, the seasonal row and new seasonal effects, a remote control D-pad, Live TV recovery, Library Order and detail screen sections.

Bug Fixes:

- Anime markers match series whose library title isn't English or romaji.
- New request notifications reach every Seerr request manager by default.
- Large MDBList rows load, since the server keeps resolving them after the app gives up.
- TMDB TV chart rows open the right show instead of a movie with the same id.
- Custom rows respect each user's parental limit. Set a server-wide TMDB key, or limited users get empty MDBList, IMDb and Letterboxd rows.
- Jellyfin Enhanced's header buttons stop opening Moonfin Web.
- In the web app, Seerr notifications reach the browser, Seerr rows load without an eight second wait after sign-in, subtitles set to Off stay off, and home rows stop going blank on Firefox.

Moonbase 2.3.0 adds the backend for anime markers, scores recommendations on the server, and keeps a backup of its settings with a restore button. It fixes message text that could wipe every plugin setting on a restart, gets the scheduled tasks running on their own again on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12, and bundles the Moonfin 2.6.0 web app.

Features:

- Anime markers flag filler, mixed, canon and recap episodes using the Anime Filler List and Tenrai, and mark Subbed or Dubbed from the audio in your own files. It's off by default, under Integrations.
- Recommendations are scored on the server. On Jellyfin 12 that scoring plugs into Jellyfin's own similar items so every client gets it, and a switch under Integrations hands it back to Jellyfin.
- Moonbase keeps a backup of its server settings and offers to restore it if they ever come back reset.
- Clients can show when a series airs next through the server, even without Sonarr.
- Admin defaults for the metadata row, the loading animation, the screensaver, the new detail screen styles, Seerr missing collection items and availability badges, the Downloads and Live TV buttons, the Rate action button, fallback audio and subtitle languages, and the Grandparents interface size.
- The bundled web app moves up to Moonfin 2.6.0, with the Spotlight, Nouveau and Minimalist detail screens, Kids Mode, Achievement Badges, a redone Live TV guide, and fonts that no longer load from Google.

Bug Fixes:

- Message text can no longer corrupt the settings file, which Jellyfin answered by resetting every setting and sometimes removing the plugin on the next start.
- Applying defaults only changes what the admin actually set.
- Scheduled tasks run on their own on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12, and custom home rows now refresh daily.
- Notifications, the media bar and genre lists stop showing items a user isn't allowed to see.
- Hidden Continue Watching and Next Up items stay hidden on every device.
- Retro game artwork is far more reliable on large libraries, and PSP games can start in Moonfin Web once the new isolation checkbox under Retro Games is on.
- The Moonfin header button shows in the Jellyfin 12 web UI.

Moonbase 2.2.0 adds server messages, so an admin can write something once and have it show up in people's apps even when they were offline while it was sent. The admin defaults page grows a lot, with settings for another 96 options and fixes to the six controls that were writing values no client reads. Retro games find more of their artwork, and it now picks up new ROMs without a restart. A reinstalled Seerr no longer strands you logged out, and a zipped game now arrives as the ROM it actually is. The bundled web client moves up to Moonfin 2.5.1.

Features:

- A new Messages tab lets an admin write a message with a title and a Markdown body, pick a colour, choose how it shows up, pick who sees it, schedule a start and end date, add a link button, and order the list. Broadcast now saves what it sends, so a user who was offline still finds it.
- Admin defaults picked up settings for another 96 options, covering discovery rows, Since You Watched, music rows, sort direction for the home rows, player buttons, media segments, Cinema Mode for episodes, and a lot more.
- Six admin controls that were writing values no client reads now send the right ones, and row sorting was rebuilt to match the clients, which also adds the missing Playlist Order option.
- Retro games now watch the configured game library folders for file changes, so a new ROM or a per-library scan runs artwork reconciliation in the background instead of waiting for a restart, and games that came out as a false miss are retried once the matching has corrected them.
- The settings sync toggle was renamed to Moonbase Sync, and its description now says that enabling it is required for the Seerr and ratings integrations.
- The bundled web client picks up everything web relevant from Moonfin 2.5.1, including the messages window, a Seerr poster grid with a download progress bar, remote subtitle badges, Play and Resume on the long press menu, and personal ratings writing to Emby.

Bug Fixes:

- A reinstalled Seerr no longer strands you logged out. The plugin was reading every 403 as missing admin rights, so the stale session was never cleared. Now it checks whether Seerr still knows the session first, and a definite refusal clears the old session and signs in again.
- A zipped game now arrives as the ROM it actually is. The detail was naming the archive, so a client saved plain ROM bytes under a .zip name and failed to unpack them. It now names the file the endpoint actually sends, along with its real size.
- A pending artwork timer can no longer take the process down on shutdown, and the artwork delivery route rejects an unknown role instead of falling through.
- The websocket reconnects after a server restart, a busy server no longer reads as a connection timeout, and Escape closes the dialog on top instead of the page behind it.

Moonbase 2.1.0 is mostly about the retro games backend, plus a personal ratings API, audiobook bookmark sync, and the bundled Moonfin web app at 2.5.0.

Features:

- Retro games: arcade ZIPs are validated offline against FBNeo and MAME DAT files, and admins can upload a DAT per core through the plugin.
- Retro games: ROMs are identified by their contents through the libretro RDB databases, with per game core and backend overrides.
- Retro games: a server side artwork pipeline with a manifest, per game artwork priority, and cached thumbnails at the requested size and format. Reconciliation runs on plugin startup and after every library scan.
- Retro games: delivery and per user concurrency limiters, a real Moonfin bridge for the EmulatorJS web player, and archive hashing capped at 512 MB per entry.
- A personal ratings endpoint serves the calling user's ratings in one response, so clients can sort and filter libraries by them.
- Audiobook bookmarks and notes are stored on the server and synced between clients.
- Clients can read their own transcode jobs, so transcoded downloads show real progress and an ETA.
- Settings sync covers everything Moonfin 2.5.0 added: HDR subtitle style, per segment skip actions, home row sort orders, the Studios row, spoiler free toggles, personal rating style, media type badges, segment auto hide, swipe gestures, scroll sensitivity, Cinema Mode for episodes, external trailers, and the crash report toggle.
- Admin defaults page: home row toggles with per row sorting defaults, Seerr Watchlist and Seerr shortcuts rows, the Aya media bar style, a Recently Released series type default, and pushing a genre, collection, or playlist row now enables its category toggle.
- The plugin reports itself as Moonbase throughout the dashboard.

Bug Fixes:

- TV studios get their logos, since TMDB networks are now read alongside production companies. Network ids are namespaced apart from company ids and the logo cache index is versioned.
- Seerr provisioning reports why it stopped instead of a bare status.
- IMDb charts stopped returning 403.
- Admin defaults: browsing and details blur defaults no longer fail the whole save, the theme music volume default is saved, and the Continue Watching image type options send values the client understands.

Web App:

- Fixes for playback control flicker, the skip button, subtitle offset range, Seerr row hover and localization, Continue Watching and Next Up paging, library search with Group By, blurry search posters, context menu placement, studio logo matching, media bar gradient flashing, backdrop fades, source pickers losing ids, book summaries, right to left layouts, and internationalized server domain names.

Features:

versions.changelog: Fix ratings saving: switched to IAuthorizationContext (Jellyfin-native API) to resolve user ID — eliminates 401 errors on POST/DELETE. Fix half-star visual with clip-path instead of overflow:hidden. Add Episode support (widget now shows on individual episode detail pages). Improve save error logging in browser console.

Fix ratings saving: corrected user ID claim lookup to use ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier so POST/DELETE endpoints correctly identify the user. Added half-star ratings (click left/right half of each star for .5 increments). Added explicit Submit button — stars select a pending rating, button sends it. Added flash feedback on save (green success/red error). Added average rating pill next to IMDb badge on detail page.

Complete injection rewrite: replaced File Transformation reflection approach with ASP.NET Core IStartupFilter + response middleware. The middleware intercepts every index.html HTTP response and injects the widget script tag directly — no file system permissions needed, no third-party plugins required. File Transformation plugin is no longer needed.

Fix: File Transformation registration now happens synchronously inside StartAsync instead of on a background thread. File Transformation finalises its callback list early during startup — registering on a background thread meant we always missed the window. This is why JavaScript Injector worked (it registers synchronously) but StarTrack did not.

Diagnostics: callback invocation counter, status, payload type and contents length now shown in /Plugins/StarTrack/Debug. Console.log added to widget.js so browser devtools shows whether the script loads and what item IDs it detects.

Fix: TransformationPatches.SetContents now wraps the modified HTML in a JValue before assigning it back to the JObject payload, fixing the silent ArgumentException that prevented File Transformation from injecting the script tag. Also: debug report now shows the real assembly version instead of hardcoded string.

Fix: File Transformation now receives a proper JObject payload (built via reflection from the already-loaded Newtonsoft.Json assembly) instead of a POCO that caused a cast exception. This is the root cause of the widget not appearing when index.html is read-only.

Diagnostic: added /Plugins/StarTrack/Debug endpoint to report injection status without needing server logs. Injection now tries multiple known Linux web paths (/usr/share/jellyfin/web, /usr/lib/jellyfin/web, etc.) in addition to the configured WebPath. Retries injection after 5 s delay. All injection log messages upgraded to Warning level so they are always visible. File Transformation registration now logs available method names if RegisterTransformation is not found.

Fix: removed Newtonsoft.Json dependency that was preventing the plugin from loading. Added File Transformation plugin integration for non-destructive index.html injection. Fixed web path resolution using IApplicationPaths.WebPath.
Initial release — star ratings for Movies and TV Shows, community average display, expandable per-user score list, and remove-rating support.

versions.changelog: Release v0.2.7.9 - Resolved Jellyfin server startup and dashboard crashes across 10.9, 10.10, and 12.0: safely extracted hardware acceleration engine via reflection to prevent TypeLoadException on Jellyfin 10.10+ where HardwareEncodingType was refactored; consolidated NotificationsConfigurationController constructor with [ActivatorUtilitiesConstructor] to guarantee deterministic DI resolution; protected dashboard injection middleware using StreamResponseBodyFeature and defensive Response.HasStarted guards against unhandled response mutation exceptions; guarded NotificationSecretStore and PluginServiceRegistrator startup with defensive try/catch logging; fixed client-side React DOM reconciliation crash (DOMException: Node.insertBefore) on dashboard updates by setting display:none instead of removeChild on heading elements; and moved pageshow listener from document to window to resolve Firefox PageTransitionEvent TypeError.

Release v0.2.7.8 - Redesigned playback cards with EasyUI Dark Precision styling, interactive cursor-tracking SpotlightCard glow, animated Playing equalizer bars, dual-track transcode buffer bar, and live transcode speed/throttle badges. Added a rolling 20-sample bandwidth sparkline and clickable stream-method filter chips to the summary strip. Simplified the density toggle to Compact (expandable on click) and Extended (always expanded inline). Hardened Discord webhook validation (supporting PTB/Canary domains and structured API error messages), auto-saved unsaved Discord/Telegram inputs when clicking Test, added Tailscale/WireGuard CGNAT (100.64.0.0/10) local IP classification and bounded geo-cache pruning, and consolidated backend admin authorization and DTOs.

Release v0.2.7.7 - Fixed the real cause of 'Telegram only sends when I click Test': every event-type checkbox (Playback Start, Stop, etc.) defaulted to off, so real playback events were silently dropped at the delivery queue's event-enablement check while the Test button, which bypasses that check, kept working. New installs now default Start/Stop to on, and existing installs are auto-recovered at save time if notifications and a destination are active with zero event types ever configured -- without overriding an explicit choice made in the same save. Saving Discord or Telegram settings now also persists the current event-subscription checkboxes, instead of only the separate Preferences section doing so. Fixed 'Copy Diagnostic Report' being permanently blocked when opened from Jellyfin's own standard Dashboard -> Plugins route, which always carries a '?name=playbackcard' query string the report's own validator was rejecting. Poster image upload failures (Discord, Telegram) no longer drop the notification outright, both now fall back to a plain text message if the image itself gets rejected. Parallelized the Local Network/Remote geolocation lookups so a page with several concurrent remote sessions and a cold cache no longer waits on them one at a time.

Release v0.2.7.6 - Discord/Telegram notifications now attach the item's poster image directly, uploaded as part of the same request rather than a link back to the server, so it works even on servers that aren't internet-reachable; falls back to text-only when no image is cached (on by default, can be turned off). The summary strip gains a live bandwidth gauge showing total outbound bitrate, split by Local Network vs. Remote when that badge is enabled, plus an optional percentage against an admin-configured upload limit. Sessions paused a while now show a warning pill (escalating from amber to red past an hour) so a forgotten paused stream holding server resources doesn't go unnoticed, and a badge appears when one account has more than one stream running. The Send Message admin action now offers quick-fill presets, and the Info panel gets a Copy Report button producing a sanitized per-session technical summary (no username, device, or IP) for sharing in a forum post or issue. Added a Recent Sessions shelf -- a short in-memory history of finished playback, cleared on restart, no database. Also fixes two Telegram bugs: saving a bot token no longer requires a Chat ID to already be set, and notification duration text no longer wraps past 24 hours.

Release v0.2.7.5 - Added a second Info view: click Info while 'Right' is selected (next to the existing 'Down' toggle) to open a centered dialog with the poster on the left and the full Tautulli-style Product/Player/Quality/Stream/Container/Video/Audio/Subtitle/Location/Bandwidth field list on the right, instead of expanding the card in place. The original Down behavior is unchanged. Transcode reasons are now itemized with red/amber severity, shown both as a details-panel banner and as warning rings on the affected pills, so it is clear at a glance why a stream is transcoding and how serious it is. Compact/Extended switches and opening Info now animate instead of snapping open. Also adds a strictly opt-in (off by default) Local Network/Remote badge, with an optional city/country lookup for remote sessions via a third-party geolocation service -- the raw IP address is never exposed or logged.

Release v0.2.7.4 - Added detection for stale, superseded plugin version folders left behind after an update. Jellyfin's own plugin loader can, in rare cases, silently keep running an old build instead of a newer one already installed (a real bug in Jellyfin itself, tracked upstream as jellyfin/jellyfin#17699) -- when that happens, fixes from later releases never take effect, with no error shown anywhere. The plugin now checks for this at every startup and logs a warning if found, and the System Diagnostics section shows a banner naming the older folder(s) with an explicit 'Remove' button per folder. Removal is always an admin-confirmed, one-click action -- never automatic -- and it refuses to remove anything unless it can positively confirm the folder belongs to this plugin and is strictly older than the version currently running.

## [1.11.0.0] - 2024-11-30

### Added

- New option to set playlists as private or public to all users

- Exception if Spotify returns duplicate playlists for a user

## [1.9.0.0] - 2024-08-25

### Added

- New setting to enable imported "progress" to be displayed in the playlist description -> #30
- New matching type to extract an album name from the track name (like 'Track [From "An Album"]') and use that for comparison

### Changed

- Updated Jellyfin dependencies to match version 10.9.9
- Switch request handling on plugin config page to use jellyfin custom fetch mechanism

# Changelog

## [1.8.1.1] - 2024-06-21

### Fixed

- Include missing Fastenshtein dependency in build artifacts

# Changelog

## [1.8.1.0] - 2024-05-19

### Fixed

- Broken API endpoints (due to authorisation policy changes in Jellyfin introduced in 10.9)

# Changelog

## [1.8.0.0] - 2024-05-17

### Added

- Support for Jellyfin 10.9
- New configurable flag for each playlist whether or not to recreate it from scratch each time the task runs
- New matching type "fuzzy checking" for track and album names

### Changed

- "Ignore Parentheses" now treats [] the same as ()
- Some rework of the track matching process (again); the plugin now tries to find all potential matches first and then decides a "best fit" track name

# Changelog

## [1.7.2.0] - 2024-03-29

### Fixed

- Accept matches where Spotify uses a different track syntax than metadata providers (e.g. "Track Name - Super Remix" on Spotify and "Track Name (Super Remix)" on MusicBrainz) if at least match level `Ignore Case + Punctuation` is used

## [1.7.1.0] - 2024-03-18

### Changed

- Reintroduce the old track matching method as a configurable legacy alternative (not recommended to be used)
- Extend logging information / debug possibilities

# Changelog

## [1.7.0.0] - 2024-03-10

- Fix broken track matching if multiple artists of a track exist in Jellyfin, but the track is not located under the first existing artist

- Catch exceptions from Spotify API lib when retrieving users / playlists

- Add new matcher to ignore anything in parentheses in track/album/artist names

- Fix bug in config page that reset all unsaved table row states when adding a new row
- Fix parsing of Spotify URLs that contain parameters
